name: DuSable Black History Museum
tagline: The first independent institution dedicated to African-American history. Founded in 1961 in Margaret Burroughs's living room.
description: The oldest independent museum of African-American history in the United States, founded by artist Margaret Burroughs in 1961 and now housed in a former Chicago Park District administration building. Permanent exhibits on slavery, the Great Migration, and the civil rights movement; strong rotating program.

tips.text: Free for Illinois residents on Sundays.

highlights.item: Harold Washington Wing — first Black mayor of Chicago
